note: The JPEG SOF header encodes component sampling factors directly into the decoder state.
The vertical sampling factor is also attacker-controlled in the crafted image.
Those factors influence buffer sizing and preserve the malformed component layout through decode.
Upsampling derives horizontal expansion directly from the header-controlled sampling value.
The vertical expansion ratio is computed the same way.
Unsupported combinations fall through to the generic resampler instead of being rejected.
